## Activity

During November 2019, West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 385 captures. This activity provides the basis for the month’s image-quality and grading review. The clinic’s capture total is reported alongside the number of images that could not be graded and the grading outcomes.

## Image quality

Of the 385 captures, 11 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.9. These images were therefore not suitable for grading. Staff raised no new equipment faults during the month.

## Grading

There were 62 referable results. The median grading lag was 2. Together, these measures describe the grading workload and the time taken for results to progress through the service during November 2019. The activity, image-quality, and grading figures should be considered together when reviewing the clinic’s monthly performance.
